I can still walk and carry out my normal routine. How many episodes occurred yesterday? Also tell me about fluid intake and whether you have started or stopped any medicines. I do not want the denied symptoms shown as present. My late marker is Indigo lantern. Final check. 12 days of brief mild dizziness on standing. No fainting, no chest pain, no shortness of breath and no current headache. No medication changes. Planned follow up is 10 days. The closing marker is Cedar Compass.
